description: This file defines a FastAPI middleware class 'PrometheusAuthMiddleware' that authenticates requests to the metrics endpoint (typically '/metrics'). It conditionally enforces authentication based on configuration, using a user API key authorization function. The middleware intercepts requests, checks if they target the metrics endpoint, and if required, performs authorization via headers, before proceeding with request handling.

classes.name: PrometheusAuthMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class to handle authentication of requests to the metrics endpoint, based on configuration settings.

methods.name: dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes incoming requests, authenticating if the endpoint is '/metrics' and authentication is enabled.

methods.name: _is_prometheus_metrics_endpoint(request: Request)
methods.description: Determines if the provided request targets the '/metrics' endpoint.

methods.name: _should_run_auth_on_metrics_endpoint()
methods.description: Checks configuration to decide if authentication should be enforced on the metrics endpoint.

ctags.name: dispatch
ctags.pattern: /^    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next):$/
